nina: Spotting a 503 spike in eu-west1 embeddings since ~22:10 UTC. I pushed a tiny restartless hotfix branch hotfix/kv-lock-1.2.7. Requesting an expedited change window 22:20-22:35 UTC to roll a cautious canary.

deploy-bot: /deploy request created repo=rl-inference ref=hotfix/kv-lock-1.2.7 env=eu-west1 strategy=restartless-canary id=DBOT-11011

sre-oncall: Risk summary: code change minimal, functional risk low. Rollout plan: 0.5% for 10m -> 5% for 10m -> 100%. Rollback triggers: error-rate > 2% OR p99 > 900ms sustained 5m. Rollback action: pin to v1.2.6 + run forced kv-clear job.

ops-lead: Runbook link: https://runbooks/kv-lock-1.2.7. PD hooks and alerting verified. Ops standing by to pin traffic.

release-manager: Draft changelog prepared; will publish after successful roll.

ops-lead: Approved. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: STARTED DBOT-11011  rolling 0.5% canary. status: https://deploys/dbot/11011/status

deploy-bot: CANARY CHECK (10m): errors 0.18% (baseline 0.12%), p99 +65ms. Within gates.

deploy-bot: PROMOTED to 5%  observing 10m.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: v1.2.7 at 100% in eu-west1. No fallback triggered. Audit: https://deploys/dbot/11011/audit

nina: thanks team, closing thread.

ops-lead: nice quick turn, will reopen if any regressions.
